results.title: McEwen Signs US$55 Million Agreement to Sell Fuller and Paymaster
results.description: McEwen Inc. has agreed to sell its Fuller and Paymaster properties in Timmins, Ontario to Discovery Mining's subsidiary Dome Mine Ltd. for US$55 million (US$5M cash, US$50M in Discovery shares). The proceeds will support McEwen's growth strategy targeting 250,000-300,000 gold equivalent ounces annually by 2030, with major projects including Stock Mine production in Q4 2026 and El Gallo construction in Mexico.

results.title: The S&P 500 Is Not Enough: My 3-Stock Starter Portfolio for New Investors
results.description: While S&P 500 index funds offer reliable long-term returns, the author recommends three individual stocks for new investors seeking more upside potential: Alphabet for its dominant search business, GE Vernova for its growing energy infrastructure backlog, and Berkshire Hathaway as a diversified holding company with Warren Buffett's proven investment philosophy.

results.title: AMC Stock Is in the Spotlight for All the Right Reasons. Here's Why It's a Buy Now.
results.description: AMC Entertainment has surged 86% in 2026 as domestic box office receipts reach their highest levels since 2019. Despite a challenging five-year track record and delayed profitability expectations until 2028, the company is benefiting from increased moviegoing, particularly among younger audiences.

results.title: Arcutis Presents ZORYVE® (roflumilast) Data and Real-World Topical Corticosteroid Research at EADV and Fall Clinical
results.description: Arcutis Biotherapeutics presented clinical data for ZORYVE (roflumilast) across multiple inflammatory skin conditions at major dermatology conferences. The INTEGUMENT-INFANT trial showed the drug was well-tolerated in infants aged 3-24 months with atopic dermatitis, with 34.4% achieving disease clearance at 4 weeks.
